comment: D3 verifier-worker golden fixtures (roadmap D3: verifier prompt-stance + strict verdict contract; docs/evals pattern). Each case drives the CORE pieces directly (executor-free): a succeeded BUILDER research assignment (its 2 citations land as evidence rows) then a VERIFIER assignment whose canned verdict envelope is parsed and applied. `expect.criteria` pins the exact per-ordinal outcome_criteria.status; `overall` is recomputed from criteria statuses (all verified → pass; any failed → fail; else partial); `extraAssignments` is always 0 — application can never mint work. Rejected cases (rejected:true) are refused FAIL-CLOSED at application (applyVerifierVerdict), leave every criterion pending, keep the assignments count at exactly builder+verifier, and the verifier assignment itself still ends succeeded — the verdict simply never reaches the criteria.
